jobs.title: Senior Analyst (Energy) | Paris
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our extensive expertise in the various Energy market ranges from market design & regulatory issues, strategy development and market modelling to comprehensive expert work in civil and antitrust / competition proceedings and carrying out due diligences for transactions. We work with utilities, energy infrastructure operators, large end-users of energy, energy regulators, law firms and investors.

You will work on both quantitative modelling and regulatory issues through a range of international projects.
Our  EMEA Energy Team , with 60 professionals across Europe, is at the forefront of the transformation of energy markets. We advise governments, regulators, energy companies, financial investors, and legal counsels on issues spanning:

- Market design and regulation of electricity, gas and hydrogen markets across the entire value chain
- Energy transition strategies, climate policy, carbon markets, and decarbonisation pathways
- Industrial decarbonisation and industrial competitiveness
- Valuation of energy assets and investment decisions for utilities, infrastructure funds, and industrials; due diligence support
- Market and financial modelling
- Competition and State aid investigations
- Regulatory and commercial disputes, including arbitration and litigation support

Our company is global and our EMEA Energy Team focuses on  Europe, Africa and the Middle East .

Our work combines  cutting-edge economic research, deep energy sector expertise  with  applied market and financial modelling  to help clients navigate the rapid transformation of energy systems.

Our recent  public studies  include, a modelling focussed study for  Energie Nederland on Resource Adequacy and the future design of the Dutch electricity market , a modelling based impact assessment of a Swedish capacity remuneration mechanism for Svenska kraftnät , a report for  Naturgy Foundation on the evolution of the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism  and a modelling focussed study for Nuclear Europe on the role of nuclear power generation in a low-carbon Europe in 2050 , Business Europe on European competitiveness in the energy and climate transition , a report for  Eurelectric on the evolution of system flexibility needs and the evolving concept of security of supply , a report for the  Clean Air Task Force on the deployment of clean power technologies .

Due to expansion of our Energy practice in Europe, we are currently looking for an experienced power market modeller/consultant with several years of professional experience in consulting, regulatory authorities or with energy utilities.

You will work on both quantitative modelling and regulatory issues across Europe.  You can be located in any of our European offices (i.e. Berlin, Düsseldorf, Paris, Brussels, London and Helsinki) and will continuously work with colleagues in other offices.

Typical duties will include:
- Quantitative analysis using our energy-specific models and using our energy system modelling platforms (power market model based on Plexos, bespoke tools in Python, data analysis)

- Preparation of reports and summaries of analysis.

- Active participation in client meetings and conference calls.

- Participation in our business development efforts

Benefits of your career at Compass Lexecon:
- A competitive salary with additional benefits

- A variety of interesting and challenging projects

- Client interaction and responsibility from day one

- Excellent development opportunities

- An international team from a variety of backgrounds and experiences

- A steep learning curve, in a supportive and collaborative team

- Comprehensive training programs

Experience and Skills Required:
- 2 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in energy consulting, with regulatory authorities or in energy utilities

- Experience in power market modelling (long-term capacity expansion, short-term dispatch), power prices projection, supply and demand dynamics, wholesale market analysis, ancillary services market analysis, power plants valuation

- Experience in power market simulation software (e.g. Plexos, BID 3, PyPSA, Antares)

- Experience in data manipulation (time series analysis, data collection and cleaning). Working knowledge of statistical packages or programming languages (Python, R, etc.)

- Master’s degree in Economics, Engineering, Finance or Statistics from a leading university

- Fluency (both spoken and written) in English is mandatory; Fluency in German or French is a plus

- Other European languages are desirable

- Advanced Excel, PowerPoint and Word skills

- Commitment to high-quality and accurate work

- Strong solution orientation and analytical skills

- Good organisational skills and ability to prioritize

- Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and clients

- Ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment

For an informal discussion on this position, please contact Pierre-Emmanuel Peslier (Senior Economist, Paris) at  ppeslier@compasslexecon.com and/or Wenkai Mi (Senior Economist, Helsinki) at wmi@compasslexecon.com .

jobs.title: Analyst | Financial Economics | London / Madrid
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our International Arbitration practice provides independent economic analysis, valuation and regulatory opinions, damages assessments, expert reports and arbitration testimony.

We believe that working in diverse teams, where everybody’s views are considered and respected, helps us to deliver work of the highest standards of quality and integrity.

We are currently recruiting for the  Analyst  position in the International Arbitration practice in our London and Madrid offices.

Our Analysts usually join us after obtaining an undergraduate degree in Economics and a Master's degree in Finance or Economics, although we also welcome applications from exceptional candidates with an undergraduate degree in Economics and an interest in corporate finance and valuation.

At Compass Lexecon, we pride ourselves on providing Analysts with an opportunity to make a real contribution from day one. As an Analyst you become an integral part of the team with the crucial role of developing robust economic analyses and valuation assessments. You will be involved in most aspects of a case, working closely with the case manager. Analysts are expected to demonstrate strong numerical skills, attention to detail, sound analytical judgment and initiative.

Analysts typically join us after completing their Master’s degree in economics.

Key Responsibilities

- Performing research to better understand clients' industries
- Collating and analysing qualitative and quantitative client data to assess clients’ businesses
- Preparing complex and customised financial valuation models using Excel
- Drafting memoranda and sections in reports summarising analyses
- Participating in client meetings and conference calls
- Contributing to discussions about the theoretical and empirical approach of the analyses

Education & Skills Required

- Master’s degree in Finance or Economics with an undergraduate degree in Economics from a leading university (we also consider undergraduates in their last year of study who have obtained or expect to obtain a first class degree in Economics and have an interest in corporate finance)
- Strong analytical skills
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to multi-task
- Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and clients
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Microsoft Office skills (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
- Fluency in English is required

Benefits of Pursuing a Career with Compass Lexecon:

- Competitive salary and benefits
- Excellent training and career opportunities
- A wide variety of interesting and challenging projects
- An international team with a broad range of backgrounds and experience
- A blend of professional and academic environments
- The opportunity to work with top law firms, corporations, government bodies and academics
- A very steep learning curve, coupled with a supportive and collaborative team
- The opportunity to take on a lot of responsibility and contribute very early on

When drafting your application:

We acknowledge that AI is now commonly used for drafting, however we emphasize the importance of personalization to truly reflect your unique experiences. We are able to recognise applications that are solely created using AI and those that demonstrate individuality.

Compass Lexecon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Analyst | Competition Practice | Düsseldorf
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our Competition Practice provides expert economic advice on competition policy, economic and financial regulation, public policy and the assessment of damages in complex disputes.

We are looking to hire junior economists to help us to provide advice to our clients on some of the most high-profile cases before the European Commission, the General Court and national competition authorities, regulators and courts.

We believe that working in diverse teams, where everybody’s views are considered and respected, helps us to deliver work of the highest standards of quality and integrity.

About the role:

We pride ourselves on providing Analysts with an opportunity to make a significant impact from day one.

You will become an integral part of Compass Lexecon’s German-speaking team, with the crucial role of helping clients understand how competition works in their industry. You will contribute to cases in a variety of ways, working closely with senior staff to understand the issues that face the client, relating those issues to relevant economic theory, and supporting the analysis with solid and persuasive empirical evidence.

You will be working on both domestic and international assignments in collaboration with our colleagues across Europe. You will also have the opportunity to influence and contribute to the growth of our German, Austrian and Swiss businesses.

Analysts typically join us after completing their Master’s degree in economics. You will be based in Compass Lexecon’s Düsseldorf office.

Applications for this position will close on  31st March 2027 .

Key responsibilities:
- Analysing qualitative and quantitative client data to better understand how competition works in their industry

- Reviewing literature and contributing to discussions about the theoretical and empirical approach

- Conducting empirical analysis using Excel and Stata

- Drafting reports summarising analysis

- Participating in client meetings and conference calls

Skills/profile sought:
- Master’s degree in economics, ideally with focus on microeconomics, industrial organisation and/or econometrics

- Fluency in English required

- Fluency in German desirable

- Highly analytical

- Excellent organisational skills with an ability to multi-task

- Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and clients

- Accuracy and attention to detail

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

- Stata and Excel skills desirable

Benefits of working at Compass Lexecon:
- Competitive salary and benefits

- A wide variety of interesting and challenging projects

- An international team with a broad range of backgrounds and experience

- A blend of professional and academic environments

- The opportunity to work with top law firms, corporations, government bodies and academics

- A steep learning curve, coupled with a supportive and collaborative team

- Opportunities for training such as secondments, office rotations, internal seminars, and conferences

- The opportunity to take on a lot of responsibility and contribute from day one

When drafting your application:

We ask all applicants to provide their most up to date CV, cover letter and transcripts.

We acknowledge that AI is now commonly used for drafting, however we emphasize the importance of personalization to truly reflect your unique experiences. We are able to recognise applications that are solely created using AI and those that demonstrate individuality.

What happens next?

Once your application has been submitted, you will receive an email confirmation outlining next steps.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, an update may be provided after the deadline of  31st March 2027. We kindly ask for your patience if you do not hear from us immediately following your application.

What does our interview process look like?

Our interview process for Analysts involves two stages. The first stage is one 60-minute interview with both motivational and technical questions. The second stage includes a written case study and a technical interview. All interviews are currently being conducted virtually.

Compass Lexecon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We appreciate that recruitment agencies may have speculative CVs that they wish to submit to Compass Lexecon. To avoid any ambiguity around fees, please note that speculative CVs received by Compass Lexecon, that have not been authorised in advance by the Recruitment team, will be ineligible for an agency fee.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: 2027 Analyst Interns - US
jobs.description:
About the Role:
We are hiring Analyst Interns to join our Competition and Finance Practices in Summer 2027. The 10-week internship will run from June through August.

Key Responsibilities
- Conduct quantitative research and analysis, including compiling, cleaning, and, analyzing large data sets.
- Conduct qualitative research and analysis, including reviewing, summarizing, and identifying relevant information from academic papers, analyst reports, press releases, industry literature and a wide range of documents produced in litigation.
- Create tables, charts, and other visual representations of analyses.
- Summarize and communicate research and analytical findings to team members.
- Ensure accuracy of work product using established audit and quality control processes.

What We're Looking For
We're looking for intellectually curious, analytically minded candidates who are eager to apply economic thinking to real-world issues. A strong academic foundation matters, but so does the drive to keep learning once you're here.

Required qualifications:
- Strong academic background pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in economics, finance, or a related quantitative field. Candidates should be completing their third year of college or their last year of a master’s program.
- Demonstrated quantitative and qualitative research and analytical skills.
- Strong interest in Economics/Finance, statistical programming and data analysis.
- Excellent written and oral communication skills.

Preferred qualifications:
- Significant coursework in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, data science, or other quantitative fields
- Introductory knowledge of Stata, SAS, R, Python or other statistical software
- Strong time management skills, with the ability to complete multiple tasks on tight deadlines while maintaining close attention to detail
- Ability to work well independently and as part of a team.

Your Development
At Compass Lexecon, the Analyst internship is designed to be a valuable launching pad for your career. From day one, the firm is committed to helping new interns grow and succeed by providing mentorship, comprehensive onboarding training, and on-the-job learning opportunities

How to Apply
Applicants must submit a cover letter, resume, unofficial transcript, and writing sample. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

Candidates should indicate which of the following opportunities they are interested in, and may indicate additional locations/practices on cover letter and application:

Finance Practice
- Chicago, IL
- New York, NY

Competition Practice
- Boston, MA
- Chicago, IL
- Los Angeles, CA
- Washington, DC

We acknowledge that AI is now commonly used for drafting, however we emphasize the importance of personalization to truly reflect your unique experiences. We are able to recognize applications that are solely created using AI and those that demonstrate individuality.

Position classification: Non-Exempt

Compass Lexecon offers a compensation package that is competitive with other major economic consulting firms. The base salary for this position is $50.00 an hour. This position is non-exempt, meaning it is eligible for overtime pay.

Summer Interns are expected to work a minimum of 40 hours per week for ten weeks with potential for overtime. Compensation is consistent with paid internships at other major economic consulting firms.

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our Competition Practice provides expert economic advice on competition policy, economic and financial regulation, public policy and the assessment of damages in complex disputes.

We are looking to hire junior economists to help us to provide advice to our clients on some of the most high-profile cases before the European Commission, the General Court and national competition authorities, regulators and courts.

We believe that working in diverse teams, where everybody’s views are considered and respected, helps us to deliver work of the highest standards of quality and integrity.

About the role:

We pride ourselves on providing Analysts with an opportunity to make a significant impact from day one. As an Analyst you will become an integral part of the team with the crucial role of helping clients understand how competition works in their industry. You will contribute to cases in a variety of ways, working closely with senior staff to understand the issues that face the client, relating those issues to relevant economic theory, and supporting the analysis with solid and persuasive empirical evidence.

Analysts typically join us after completing their Master’s degree in economics.

Applications for this position will close on  31st March 2027 .

Key responsibilities:
- Analysing qualitative and quantitative client data to better understand how competition works in their industry

- Reviewing literature and contributing to discussions about the theoretical and empirical approach

- Conducting empirical analysis using Excel and Stata

- Drafting reports summarising analysis

- Participating in client meetings and conference calls

Skills/profile sought:
- Master’s degree in economics, ideally with focus on microeconomics, industrial organisation and/or econometrics

- Highly analytical

- Excellent organisational skills with an ability to multi-task

- Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and clients

- Accuracy and attention to detail

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

- Stata and Excel skills desirable

- Fluency in French and English required, other languages (German, Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese) are a plus

Benefits of working at Compass Lexecon:
- Competitive salary and benefits

- A wide variety of interesting and challenging projects

- An international team with a broad range of backgrounds and experience

- A blend of professional and academic environments

- The opportunity to work with top law firms, corporations, government bodies and academics

- A steep learning curve, coupled with a supportive and collaborative team

- Opportunities for training such as secondments, office rotations, internal seminars, and conferences

- The opportunity to take on a lot of responsibility and contribute from day one

When drafting your application:

We ask all applicants to provide their most up to date CV, cover letter and transcripts.

We acknowledge that AI is now commonly used for drafting, however we emphasize the importance of personalization to truly reflect your unique experiences. We are able to recognise applications that are solely created using AI and those that demonstrate individuality.

What happens next?

Once your application has been submitted, you will receive an email confirmation outlining next steps.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

What does our interview process look like?
Our interview process for Analysts involves two stages. The first stage is one 60-minute interview with both motivational and technical questions. The second stage includes a written case study and a technical interview. All interviews are currently being conducted virtually.

Compass Lexecon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We appreciate that recruitment agencies may have speculative CVs that they wish to submit to Compass Lexecon. To avoid any ambiguity around fees, please note that speculative CVs received by Compass Lexecon, that have not been authorised in advance by the Recruitment team, will be ineligible for an agency fee.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Analyst - Beijing - Q3 2026
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our Competition Practice provides expert economic advice on competition policy, economic and financial regulation, public policy and the assessment of damages in complex disputes.

We are looking to hire economists to help us to provide advice to our clients on some of the most high-profile cases before competition authorities regulators and courts in the Asia-Pacific region and beyond.

We believe that working in diverse teams, where everybody’s views are considered and respected, helps us to deliver work of the highest standards of quality and integrity.

Compass Lexecon is internationally recognized as a leading economic consulting firm with 22 offices around the world. Our Beijing/Shanghai office has an immediate opening for a full-time Analyst position. While this position is based in Beijing/Shanghai, the Analyst is also expected to collaborate frequently with Compass Lexecon’s economists in the US and Europe.

Ideal candidates would hold a master’s degree in Economics or a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, or Data Science), or a bachelor’s degree in these fields. We seek candidates who possess strong academic backgrounds. Demonstration of quantitative skills, writing ability, and qualitative research skills are required.  Knowledge of Excel and statistical programming packages such as STATA, Python, SAS, or R are preferred. Candidates must be highly motivated, analytical, detail-oriented, able to work independently and in teams, and have excellent oral and written communication skills. Native in Mandarin and professional fluency in English are required.

The position demands strong ability to perform quantitative analysis, knowledge of or interest in economics, and a broad range of research skills. Analysts are involved in nearly all aspects of project work, interacting closely with other analysts, directors, and firm principals in analysing data, preparing client presentations, and drafting reports. Through their involvement, Analysts gain a comprehensive understanding of the industries and public policy issues relevant to the projects we work on. As skills and competencies develop, there will be greater opportunity for independent work and client interaction.

A cover letter, resume, transcript, and a writing sample must be submitted to our online applicant tracking database in order to be considered for the position.
